Mastering Technical SEO and Generative Engine Optimization

Technical SEO ensures crawlers and generative AI engines can discover, parse, and cite your authoritative content accurately.

What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring website content so AI answer engines (like Perplexity and Google SGE) can reliably extract accurate facts and provide direct citations.

Core GEO Best Practices

  • Provide clear definition sentences directly below question headings.
  • Use standard Schema.org JSON-LD to declare entities.
  • Publish structured tables and bulleted lists for direct factual synthesis.
